label: Bible Study
prompt: But God hath chosen the _____ things of the world to confound the wise; and God hath chosen the weak things of the world to confound the things which are mighty;
verse: But God hath chosen the foolish things of the world to confound the wise; and God hath chosen the weak things of the world to confound the things which are mighty;
note: God's recruiting strategy — the foolish and the weak, to put the wise and mighty in their place.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And David was greatly distressed; for the people spake of stoning him, because the soul of all the people was grieved, every man for his sons and for his daughters: but David _____ himself in the LORD his God.
verse: And David was greatly distressed; for the people spake of stoning him, because the soul of all the people was grieved, every man for his sons and for his daughters: but David encouraged himself in the LORD his God.
note: David's worst day at Ziklag — his own men talking of stoning him — and he encouraged himself in the LORD.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And when she knew Peter's voice, she opened not the gate for _____, but ran in, and told how Peter stood before the gate.
verse: And when she knew Peter's voice, she opened not the gate for gladness, but ran in, and told how Peter stood before the gate.
note: Rhoda was so glad to hear Peter's voice that she ran to tell everyone — and left him standing at the gate.

label: Deep Water
prompt: He stretcheth out the north over the empty place, and hangeth the earth upon _____.
verse: He stretcheth out the north over the empty place, and hangeth the earth upon nothing.
note: Job pictures the earth hanging on nothing — a striking image for an ancient poet.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Now therefore let Pharaoh look out a man _____ and wise, and set him over the land of Egypt.
verse: Now therefore let Pharaoh look out a man discreet and wise, and set him over the land of Egypt.
note: Joseph's advice to Pharaoh: find a man 'discreet and wise' — and Pharaoh promptly decided Joseph was that man (41:39).
